verdict.line: You lose if you stand still through Q (Thundering Smash) and trade into his W (Frenzied Maul) recast heal; you win if you trade only when his Q is down and silence the W recast with Q (Decisive Strike).

brief.thesis: Volibear's kit is built to start fights on his terms and heal through the end of them: Q (Thundering Smash) closes distance and stuns the first thing he hits, then W (Frenzied Maul) recast on the same target deals bonus damage and heals him. Garen has no way to prevent the stun itself, but Decisive Strike's silence can remove the W recast heal from a trade he's already losing. The 50.1% head-to-head over 2208 games says this is close on paper; the 'Volibear lane advantage' tag says the gap is in who starts the fight, not raw damage.

theirWindow.what: He can dash to you from 300 range, stun on the hit, then chain W (Frenzied Maul) twice for the recast heal. Don't stand in his dash lane when his Q timer looks full — hold at the edge of 300 range instead.

yourWindow.when: right after he lands or whiffs Q
yourWindow.what: His Q is now 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s away. Walk in and spam E (Judgment) for free physical damage, and save Q (Decisive Strike) to silence him the moment he tries the W recast so he can't heal off it.

start.why: Volibear's W applies on-hit poke every 5 seconds and his passive adds bonus magic damage on top — the sustain and damage reduction from Doran's Shield keeps you from losing the lane to chip damage alone (49.3% win rate, 55% pick).

boots.why: The standard pick at 51.2% win rate over 1844 games — more attacks landed means more E (Judgment) ticks and faster stacking toward trades you can win.

core.why: Highest-performing core path (57.8% over 457 games); the slow on-hit lets you stick through his Q burst of speed instead of getting kited after he disengages.
Attack speed compounds with E (Judgment)'s short cooldown to out-trade his passive attack speed stacking.
Directly answers the matchup's core problem — Volibear's W recast heal and passive sustain. Grievous Wounds removes the reason he wins extended fights.

situational.when: if he is rushing early sustain and you need the healing cut before Mortal Reminder completes
if you need to close the gap faster since he has no slow immunity on approach
if you want to force fights on cooldown windows rather than wait for him to engage

runes.keystoneWhy: This is a sustained-trade matchup decided by who's still landing hits at the end of the fight — Conqueror's stacking adaptive force and healing reward you for staying in range and spamming E (Judgment) rather than trading once and resetting.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 93.1% of games at a solid 51.3% win rate — Ignite punishes his W recast heal directly by applying Grievous Wounds early, before your Mortal Reminder is online.

playing.title: Trade only when his Q is down
playing.detail: Watch his Q (Thundering Smash) cooldown — 12s at rank 1, down to 10s at rank 5. Walking up while it's available means eating a stun into a W chain.

playing.title: Silence the W recast, not the Q
playing.detail: Decisive Strike's silence can't stop the initial Q stun, but it can stop him from recasting W (Frenzied Maul) on you for the bonus damage and heal mid-fight.

playing.title: Don't face-check brush before trading
playing.detail: Sky Splitter has 1200 range and can land on you from out of sight. Clear vision before committing to an extended trade near his likely cast spots.

playing.title: Back off to use your passive
playing.detail: Perseverance regenerates a percentage of your health per second once you've gone a few seconds without being hit — disengage after a trade instead of forcing a second exchange.

playing.title: Spam E for trade damage, not just waveclear
playing.detail: Judgment's cooldown drops to 9s at rank 5 — use it every time it's up during a fight, not just to clear casters.

playing.title: Hold R for the execute window
playing.detail: Demacian Justice only reaches 400 range, so land it right after a trade when he's already low rather than opening with it.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning for why those numbers look the way they do is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Volibear’s (E) used out of sight. Purchase items that reduce healing and fight him when his abilities are on cooldown.
